notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 object-lifecycle slice to the exact no-time C++ Delete Object Instance and Remove Object Instance surfaces exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies only official signatures, declared exception sets, adapter symbols, and real Catch2 selectors. The development profile accepts deletion only from the federate that currently owns HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject, makes that invoking federate unknown immediately, delivers one no-time removal callback to every other known recipient through its immediate or evoked model, and preserves the supplied tag and producing federate. Timestamped/retraction deletion, local delete, attribute update/reflection, ownership transfer, DDM, FOM sharing policy, save/restore, resign-action disposition, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
